{{Top}}
{{Quote|Vision detects an extremely wide spectrum, including ultra-violet, infra-red and beyond.|[[Lyrre T'enna]], on [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawkbats]] in her [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]]|<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''spectrum''' was a pattern of light. The electromagnetic spectrum consisted of visible light, [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] light, [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] light, [[Gamma ray/Legends|gamma rays]], [[X-ray/Legends|x-rays]], and many other types of light. Different [[Species/Legends|species]] were sensitive to different spectrums of light. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] were just two examples of species whose [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] could see visible light. [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] and [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] were sensitive to ultraviolet light. Some species, such as [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] could see in multiple spectrums, however, they could only see [[Color/Legends|color]] in one: ultraviolet.
